# AkumaLib

<div class="mod-page-icon" markdown="1">

![](../../assets/mods/akumalib.png)

| Parry | `akumalib:parry` | Raises the baton to guard. The first blow from in front is blocked, then the user strikes back. |
| Spear Charge | `akumalib:spear_charge` | Rushes straight ahead, spear first. The enemies in the way are hit and thrown back. |

| Thrust | `akumalib:thrust` | Draws the spear back, then thrusts it far ahead in a straight line. |
